parsed.ceo_summary: Implementing this lightweight server significantly expands our smoke testing surface area, guaranteeing robust connectivity validation across all deployment environments.
constraints: Must implement a minimal HTTP server capable of echoing received requests (GET/POST).
Must use a structured logging format (e.g., JSON) for all access, error, and lifecycle events.
Should expose a clear API/interface for programmatic invocation by the CI test runner.
Must be dependency-managed and kept isolated from core business logic.
parsed.cpo_summary: We must ensure the library adheres to clean architecture principles, keeping the server implementation highly modular and the logging mechanism standardized for easy integration with existing monitoring tools.
parsed.rationale: The HTTP echo server is a reusable utility component that provides core functionality for the smoke testing suite. Structuring it as a library ensures it can be easily integrated as a dependency within the existing CI framework without polluting the main application codebase.
